releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v7.0.6 — AI FrameGen Lighting & HAGS Hardware Doubler:
- Active FrameGen Lighting: The active FrameGen button now dynamically lights up with a glowing neon accent fill and pulsing border.
- HAGS Hardware FrameGen Enabler: Auto-enables Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HwSchMode: 2) in Windows 11 to unlock RTX 4060 Optical Flow AI frame generation.
- DirectFlip Presentation Model: Disables GameDVR background capture and forces DirectFlip (FSEBehaviorMode: 2) for minimum render latency.
- AntiCheatGuardian: Zero-conflict protection for EA Javelin, EAC, Vanguard, and BattlEye.
